_instructions: Fill value + source + date for each answer you can CONFIRM. Leave value null if unknown; it will not be applied.

offer_funder.question: Who funds the EXACT proposed digital offer (retailer, manufacturer or shared), and who reimburses whom?
offer_funder.unit: text: retailer | manufacturer | shared + reimbursement terms

retailer_share_of_face_value.question: What share of the offer's face value does the RETAILER bear after any reimbursement (incl. any retailer match)?

offer_face_value_usd.question: Face value of the proposed offer per redemption.

redemption_mechanic.question: How is the offer redeemed / opted into (clip to card, automatic at checkout, code at checkout)?

redemption_share_of_baseline_buyers.question: Of contacted households who would buy anyway, what share redeem the offer (from your past digital offers)?

active_customer_households.question: Active loyalty households in the eligible base (all segments).

eligible_consented_digital_households.question: Of those, households with valid consent for digital offers.

contribution_margin_rate.question: Contribution margin on the category's retailer receipts (after cost of goods, before marketing).

setup_cost_usd.question: One-off setup cost per campaign wave (creative, configuration, QA, legal review).

contact_cost_digital_usd.question: Cost per digital contact (send + platform fee).

stock_capacity_purchasing_households_4w.question: For each category, how many purchasing households among CONTACTED households can stock support per 4 weeks (baseline + extra buyers)?
